newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Proton to invest 7 mln stg in Lotus UK plant.
newsitem.headline: Proton to invest 7 mln stg in Lotus UK plant.

text.p: Malaysian car maker Proton said on Saturday that it is investing seven million stg in engineering facilities at British sports car maker Group Lotus Ltd's Hethel, Norfolk plant.
Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton) last month announced it and its chairman Yahaya Ahmad had jointly bought an 80 percent stake in Lotus for 51 million stg ($82 million).
In a statement, Proton said the investment in the Proton Project Centre at Hethel will allow it to undertake engineering design and prototype vehicle body design.
Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad was due to visit the Hethel plant on Saturday.
The Proton centre will be supported by 150 engineers and technicians, Proton said, but gave no further details.
Proton acquired the stake in Lotus, which also provides design engineering services, to obtain technology expertise.
